full_name: Jane Kamensky | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 History Emeline Bigelow Conland Fellow Brandeis University
bio: ane Kamensky is an associate professor of history at Brandeis University, where she offers courses in colonial American history, women’s and family history, and the writing of history.
